interaction_history.overview: Two thirtysomethings, unemployed former alcoholic Joe and community health worker Sarah, start a romantic relationship in the one of the toughest Glasgow neighbourhoods.
interaction_history.title: My Name Is Joe

interaction_history.overview: New York City detective Daniel Ciello agrees to help the United States Department of Justice help eliminate corruption in the police department, as long as he will not have to turn in any close friends. In doing so, Ciello uncovers a conspiracy within the force to smuggle drugs to street informants
interaction_history.title: Prince of the City

interaction_history.overview: The life of a divorced television writer dating a teenage girl is further complicated when he falls in love with his best friend's mistress.
interaction_history.title: Manhattan

interaction_history.overview: The Coen Brothers tell the story of a absurd yet likable family with an unproductive couple as the focal point. The couple has gotten themselves into some trouble while kidnapping a baby and give Hollywood one of the most memorable chase scenes to date.
interaction_history.title: Raising Arizona

interaction_history.overview: A collection of seven vignettes, which each address a question concerning human sexuality.
interaction_history.title: Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex

interaction_history.overview: The young Harold lives in his own world of suicide-attempts and funeral visits to avoid the misery of his current family and home environment. Harold meets an 80-year-old woman named Maude who also lives in her own world yet one in which she is having the time of her life. When the two opposites meet they realize that their differences don’t matter and they become best friends and love each other.
interaction_history.title: Harold and Maude

interaction_history.overview: Ike Graham, New York columnist, writes his text always at the last minute. This time, a drunken man in his favourite bar tells Ike about Maggie Carpenter, a woman who always flees from her grooms in the last possible moment. Ike, who does not have the best opinion about females anyway, writes an offensive column without researching the subject thoroughly.
interaction_history.title: Runaway Bride

interaction_history.overview: Max Rockatansky returns as the heroic loner who drives the dusty roads of a postapocalyptic Australian Outback in an unending search for gasoline. Arrayed against him and the other scraggly defendants of a fuel-depot encampment are the bizarre warriors commanded by the charismatic Lord Humungus, a violent leader whose scruples are as barren as the surrounding landscape.
interaction_history.title: Mad Max 2 (a.k.a. The Road Warrior)

interaction_history.overview: Two schizophrenics meet during therapy and fall in love. Unfortunately they are on a road to nowhere...
interaction_history.title: Angel Baby

interaction_history.overview: A weak-willed Italian man becomes a fascist flunky who goes abroad to arrange the assassination of his old teacher, now a political dissident.
interaction_history.title: Conformist, The (Il Conformista)
